name: Poster Overlays
description: Burns quality badges (4K, Dolby Vision, HDR10, IMAX, Dolby Atmos, DTS) into movie posters using Agregarr overlay templates, so they show in every Jellyfin client. Originals are backed up and can be restored.
overview: Quality badges on movie posters, in every client

versions.changelog: Pack badges without gaps and detect Atmos/DTS:X on any audio track
Auto-apply overlays to new and upgraded movies within 30 seconds
First release: Agregarr templates, poster backup/restore, settings page
